<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit to detect input pattern '10011'</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating whether the detected pattern matches.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="s0">State representing the initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1">State representing the first character '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2">State representing the second character '0'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3">State representing the third character '0'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s4">State representing the fourth character '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s5">State representing the final character '1'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <case>
            <condition>
                <equal><left>RST</left><right>1'b1</right></equal>
            </condition>
            <then>
                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
            </then>
            <else>
                <case>
                    <condition>
                        <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></equal>
                    </condition>
                    <then>
                        <if>
                            <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b1</right></equal>
                            <then>
                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s1</right></assign>
                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                            </then>
                            <else>
                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                            </else>
                        </if>
                    </then>
                    <else>
                        <case>
                            <condition>
                                <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s1</right></equal>
                            </condition>
                            <then>
                                <if>
                                    <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b0</right></equal>
                                    <then>
                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s2</right></assign>
                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                    </then>
                                    <else>
                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                    </else>
                                </if>
                            </then>
                            <else>
                                <case>
                                    <condition>
                                        <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s2</right></equal>
                                    </condition>
                                    <then>
                                        <if>
                                            <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b0</right></equal>
                                            <then>
                                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s3</right></assign>
                                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                            </then>
                                            <else>
                                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                            </else>
                                        </if>
                                    </then>
                                    <else>
                                        <case>
                                            <condition>
                                                <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s3</right></equal>
                                            </condition>
                                            <then>
                                                <if>
                                                    <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b1</right></equal>
                                                    <then>
                                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s4</right></assign>
                                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                                    </then>
                                                    <else>
                                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                                    </else>
                                                </if>
                                            </then>
                                            <else>
                                                <case>
                                                    <condition>
                                                        <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s4</right></equal>
                                                    </condition>
                                                    <then>
                                                        <if>
                                                            <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b1</right></equal>
                                                            <then>
                                                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s5</right></assign>
                                                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b1</right></assign>
                                                            </then>
                                                            <else>
                                                                <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                                                <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                                            </else>
                                                        </if>
                                                    </then>
                                                    <else>
                                                        <case>
                                                            <condition>
                                                                <equal><left>CURRENT_STATE</left><right>s5</right></equal>
                                                            </condition>
                                                            <then>
                                                                <if>
                                                                    <equal><left>IN</left><right>1'b0</right></equal>
                                                                    <then>
                                                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s2</right></assign>
                                                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                                                    </then>
                                                                    <else>
                                                                        <assign><left>NEXT_STATE</left><right>s0</right></assign>
                                                                        <assign><left>MATCH</left><right>1'b0</right></assign>
                                                                    </else>
                                                                </if>
                                                            </then>
                                                        </case>
                                                    </else>
                                                </case>
                                            </then>
                                        </case>
                                    </then>
                                </case>
                            </then>
                        </case>
                    </then>
                </case>
            </else>
        </case>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Continuous assignment for next_state and match based on current_state and in.</implementation>
</module>
